summary: These updates improve media decoding and encoding across Android, Linux, and FFmpeg, including Widevine-protected audio, AVC and HEVC timing in Matroska (MKV), and Android’s handling of H.264 settings and frame sizes. Linux Vulkan Video hardware decoding gets fixes for device and memory handling, while FFmpeg and AV1 changes improve support for video color information so it is preserved through decoding and encoding. Several changes also tighten protected-playback recovery and improve how Firefox selects and checks which decoders can handle a stream.
